command:
cat >/dev/null
o=holds; r='every section each document refers to is one of its provisions'
for f in /inputs/*; do
  m=$(awk '
    { line = $0
      if (match(line, /^[ \t]*((Section|Clause|Article) )?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*\./)) {
        h = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH)
        sub(/^[ \t]*((Section|Clause|Article) )?/, "", h)
        sub(/\.$/, "", h)
        have[h] = 1
      }
      while (match(line, /([Ss]ection|[Cc]lause|[Aa]rticle)s? [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*/)) {
        ref = substr(line, RSTART, RLENGTH)
        sub(/^[A-Za-z]+ /, "", ref)
        refs[ref] = 1
        line = substr(line, RSTART + RLENGTH)
      }
    }
    END { for (ref in refs) if (!(ref in have)) print ref }' "$f" | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//; s/,/, /g')
  if [ -n "$m" ]; then o=does_not_hold; r="$(basename "$f") refers to sections $m, which it does not contain"; fi
done
printf '{"protocol":"capsulet.verifier/v1","results":[{"obligation":"references-resolve","contract":"contract-clauses","outcome":"%s","reason":"%s"}]}' "$o" "$r"
